snippet.title: THE SEVENTH SCREENING - TEASER TRAILER
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977410/The_Seventh_Screening/

Tonight, Hollywood gathers for the glittering premiere of Farewell From Forever, the directorial debut and final picture of silver screen legend Don Holloway - you.

When the applause fades and the stars leave for the afterparty, you find yourself alone in echoing halls, trapped with the one audience you can never escape: yourself.
